name: Bubbly Image Reveal
description: Fixed WebGL canvas where each image sits in its own viewport-height scroll section and is revealed through a bubbly, wobbling circle mask shader as you scroll to it.
contents: Fixed large uppercase heading at the bottom right
behavior: Camera follows page scroll with smoothing
Entering a section animates its shader progress from 0 to 1, growing a blobby circle cluster that reveals the image
Heading uses difference blend mode over the canvas
editableByProps: Images, their plane sizes and number of sections
Heading text, background and heading colors
Reveal duration, camera settings and scroll smoothing

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the bubble shape or reveal pattern

needsCodeEdit.where: h1 element in the returned JSX

fixed: Canvas is fixed to the viewport and sized to the window, driven by window scroll
Adds window scroll and resize listeners while mounted and removes them on unmount
Renders one h-screen section per image to provide scroll range
Reveal starts only after all textures have loaded
